Sourav Ganguly, the legendary former Indian cricket captain, faces a significant security recalibration following a decision by the West Bengal government to reduce his protective detail. When state resources are withdrawn, the burden of protection shifts to private sector solutions, requiring a sophisticated approach to personal safety and asset management.
